nodes.label: Journey 01 — Pair a device
nodes.rationale: Everything else in the product is behind pairing, and its breakage is the most invisible — a broken pairing link still returns a perfectly valid-looking page. Traps: a document navigation to /pair?t=… must be answered by the server (which verifies the token, sets the cookie and redirects) not the SPA shell — this regressed once returning 200 the whole time and is now pinned by src/channels/web/spa-navigation.test.ts; on Android the link must survive onboarding or the intent is consumed before ConnectPage composes.
